integrity: Every finite diagnostic is reproducible with the included standard-library checker; the infinite claim rests on the explicit earlier-occurrence and first-zero-run induction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the canonical online greedy attractor of the powers-of-two characteristic sequence, not the minimum offline attractor. Literature comparisons cannot guarantee bibliographic uniqueness; an unindexed equivalent Lempel-Ziv phrase-boundary statement may exist. Finite tests are not proof of the infinite statement.
title: Exact greedy string attractor of the powers-of-two characteristic word
